trace_order: append-only JSONL line order is the canonical event sequence when the adapter does not emit event_sequence
checkpoint_generation: every CHECKPOINT_WRITE creates one new active generation
restore_binding: each POST_ROLLBACK_BEFORE_NEXT_INPUT binds only to the latest chronologically preceding active generation
identity_checks: meshPhi persistent or approved deterministic reconstruction
forbidden: keying checkpoints only by adapter window_id
choosing a closest checkpoint when lifecycle order is missing or ambiguous
treating missing state inventory as pass
failure_policy: missing checkpoint, restore before checkpoint, nonmonotonic sequence, time/timeIndex mismatch, missing inventory, or state mismatch is FAIL
